_evidence: 0x00419d76 (ebx = 0x006380d8) combines dwords +0x80/+0x84/+0x88 of the four 0x300-byte records in sums and differences, scales them by the Q12 gains 0x00638d6c..0x00638d8c (imul, shrd 12) and stores three totals to 0x006228e8/ec/f0. The dwords are per-record run-time state (force components) used only in add/sub/imul, so any i32 is valid for all four records.
